name: Quick Reply
description: One-click reply chips (OK, Yes, Approved, Go, gg, Explain) above the composer, for when the agent asks a question and the answer is a single word. Only the first chip shows; the others open to its left on hover. Misclick protection: a click guard and a send delay (hold or click to fill). Optional action log.
author: Piotr-Vasiuchonak-EPAM

settings_schema.label: Chips
settings_schema.description: Comma separated list, 8 chips at most. The first chip is always visible. The others open to its left, in list order, nearest to the first chip first.

settings_schema.label: Click guard
settings_schema.description: Ignore presses right after a new reply appears and while the chip group opens.

settings_schema.label: Guard time (ms)
settings_schema.description: 0-3000. How long presses are ignored after a new reply appears.

settings_schema.label: Send delay
settings_schema.description: The chip fills before it sends. Hold: press and hold until full; early release or leaving the chip cancels. Click: a click starts the fill; a second click or Esc cancels. Off: the first click sends.

settings_schema.label: Click time (ms)
settings_schema.description: 500-10000. Fill time in mode Click to start.

settings_schema.label: Applies to
settings_schema.description: Which chips use the send delay. Extra chips = all except the first one.

settings_schema.label: Log actions
settings_schema.description: Record press, hold, cancel, send, blocked and mode change. Chip labels and times only, no chat text. View with Show log.
